limitations: Manufacturer populated mechanical STEP retained; CPU/board/peripheral runtime unavailable.
No physical hardware measurements; colors are photograph-informed approximations, not calibrated materials.
STEP component384 is an isolated cylinder at x≈-159,y≈-50mm, outside the15×18mm board; excluded with original bounds preserved. All other solids and27 orphan shells retained.
Shield etched text and PCB silk are absent from mechanical STEP; visual label coverage is partial.
assemblyNotes: Native STEP solids, open shells and standalone faces in stable source order; single rigid centering/orientation transform without rescaling. Colors/names read from XCAF; missing values remain explicit unknown. Native board is rotated minus90degrees around Z, putting both antenna connectors on photo-right.

omittedComponents.reason: Isolated source cylinder outside assembled board envelope; exact source coordinates retained in step-styles.json. No invented relocation.
